# On-screen text

Every word that appears on screen, in order, with its type spec. Type tokens are from
`brand-kit.html`; the dark ("Lantern") set is used throughout because the film is at night and
the app is in dark mode.

**Nothing in this file gets generated by Runway.** All of it is set in HTML or After Effects and
composited. See `05-noah-ui-screens.md`.

---

## The numbers are internally consistent — keep them that way

The brief's figures needed one correction. **A full charge projected at 2h 06m means a drain of
0.79% per minute, so losing 41% → 29% takes about fifteen minutes, not six.** The stopwatch
therefore reads **00:15:12**, and the row is labelled *projected battery life, full charge* so it
cannot be misread as "2 hours left from 29%."

If any of these change, re-derive the others:

| Quantity | Before | After | Ties to |
|---|---|---|---|
| Projected battery life, full charge | 2h 06m | 5h 41m | the stopwatch and the % sequence |
| Drain rate implied | 0.79 %/min | 0.29 %/min | 100 ÷ minutes |
| % lost over the stopwatch window | 12 (41→29) | — | 0.79 × 15.2 min |
| Stopwatch | **00:15:12** | — | 12 ÷ 0.79 |
| Background energy impact | 94.2 avg | 0.4 | macOS Activity Monitor metric |
| Idle CPU | 61% of a core | 2% | consistent with the helper quitting |
| Duration at this level | 4h 12m | — | she started work ~19:30, clock reads 23:41 |

**More conservative option if legal prefers it:** `2h 06m → 4h 12m` (a clean 2×). The rest of the
package works unchanged.

## Screen by screen

### UI-01 — battery cluster, plugged in · clip 02
```
41%        →        38%
```
Charging bolt lit. Menu-bar clock reads `23:41`.
*Jakarta 500, tabular numerals, `--ink` `#EBEDF2`. Bolt in `--ink-2` `#B4BCC8`.*
The change happens across a rack-focus soft frame, never as a live tick — see the note at the end
of this file.

```
34%        →        29%
```

```
My battery keeps dying way too fast.
```

*Jakarta 400, `--ink`. Caret in `--accent-indigo` `#6366F1`. Send control at rest — the aurora

### UI-05 — Noah measuring · clip 10
```
NOAH IS MEASURING

  ✓  Battery health and cycle count
  ✓  Charge and discharge history
  ◐  Energy impact per process — sampling 60s
  ·  Login items and background agents
  ·  Sleep, wake and idle power state

  41 processes sampled · 60s window
```
*Eyebrow: Jakarta 700, 0.14em tracking, uppercase, flat `--accent-indigo`. Checks: Jakarta 500,
`--ink-2`; completed check marks in commit teal `#14B8A6`. Last line mono, `--mute` `#7A8290`.*

Named checks, never a progress bar — `brand-kit.html` calls a bar performing work that isn't

### UI-06 — the finding · clip 12
```
NOAH FOUND THE ACTUAL CAUSE

Northwind Drive's sync helper never stopped running.

NorthwindSyncHelper          PID 40218
Energy impact 94.2 avg · 61% of one core · 4h 12m at this level

It's stuck retrying an upload that failed four hours ago.
While it runs, your Mac can't drop into its low-power idle
state — so the battery drains as if you were working.
```
*Headline: Jakarta 700, −0.035em tracking, `--ink`. Mono block: JetBrains Mono 400, `--ink-2`,
with `94.2` and `61%` in amber `#F59E0B` — caution, not decoration. Body: Jakarta 400, `--ink-2`.*

No exclamation, no warning triangle, no red. The brand kit's ban on invented urgency applies
hardest here, because here is where the scare-software category would put it.

### UI-07 — the proposal · clip 13 · **the frame the campaign turns on**
```
WHAT NOAH WILL DO

1.  Quit the helper.
    NorthwindSyncHelper (PID 40218)

2.  Stop it starting again at login.
    ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.northwind.drive.sync.plist → .noah_bak

Northwind Drive still works. You'll open it yourself when you want to sync.

↺  Reversible. Noah keeps the backup and can put it back.

        [ APPROVE ]        Not now
```
*Numbered lines: Jakarta 600, `--ink`. Paths and process names: JetBrains Mono 400, `--ink-2` —
the `→ .noah_bak` form is the brand kit's own machine-voice sample. Reassurance line: Jakarta 400,
`--ink-2`. Reversibility line: Jakarta 500, commit teal `#14B8A6`.*

**APPROVE** is the only element in the entire film carrying the aurora gradient
`linear-gradient(135deg,#5B9BD5,#6366F1,#8B5CF6)`, with white Jakarta 700 at 0.06em tracking.
**Not now** is a bare text button in `--mute` with no border and no fill. The asymmetry is
deliberate and is the brand rule: *the gradient marks the one thing to do next.*

### UI-09 — the recheck · clip 18
```
SAME CHECK, RUN AGAIN

                          BEFORE            AFTER

Background energy impact    94.2              0.4
Idle CPU                    61% of a core      2%
Projected battery life,     2h 06m          5h 41m
full charge

Measured on this Mac, tonight. Yours will differ.
```
*Column heads: Jakarta 700 uppercase 0.13em, BEFORE in `--mute`, AFTER in commit teal. Values:
JetBrains Mono 500, tabular, BEFORE in `--ink-2`, AFTER in `--ink`. Footnote: Jakarta 400,
`--mute`, 60% of body size.*

The footnote is not fine print hedging a claim — it is the claim, stated accurately. Keep it
legible; do not shrink it to get the numbers bigger.

### UI-10 — end card · clip 21
```
                      [ Noah mark ]

                          NOAH

              Describe it. Approve it. Done.

          Find what's actually wrong with your Mac.

                       onnoah.app

  Results depend on device condition, configuration, battery
  health, and the cause of the issue.
```

| Element | Spec |
|---|---|
| Mark | `brand-pack/svg/noah-mark-dark.svg`, 240px on a 3840×2160 frame. Level, unglowed, no shadow, waterline overshoot intact, clear space ≥ the ring stroke on all sides. |
| NOAH | Jakarta 700, 140px, −0.035em, `--ink` `#EBEDF2` |
| Tagline | Jakarta 700, 104px, −0.03em. `Describe it.` and `Done.` in `--ink`; **`Approve it.` in the aurora gradient** — the film's second and last use of it |
| Descriptor | Jakarta 400, 52px, `--ink-2` `#B4BCC8` |
| URL | Jakarta 500, 56px, `--accent-indigo` `#6366F1`, flat — not gradient |
| Legal super | Jakarta 400, 30px, `--mute` `#7A8290`, lower edge, 120px margin, 260px side inset |
| Ground | Night `#0B1024`, flat, no vignette, no gradient wash |

**Cross-platform variant** (only if Windows has shipped — see `00-brand-notes` §1): descriptor
becomes `Find the real cause of your PC problems.` Nothing else changes.

**"Done." is not teal here.** On the end card it is a promise, not a confirmation. Teal is
reserved for something that actually succeeded, which on the end card nothing has.

### UI-11 — resting desktop · clip 20
The screen in the wide pull-back. A calm dark desktop, menu bar reading `00:02` and **`29%`**,
no bolt, no Noah window, no notification. It is at rest.

**The percentage must not move in this shot.** That stillness is the last argument the film
makes, and an animated tick here would undo it.

## Legal super — placement rules

> Results depend on device condition, configuration, battery health, and the cause of the issue.

- On screen from **frame 766 to 816** — 50 frames, 2.08s. Two seconds is the floor; do not trim
  the end card to save time.
- 30px on a 2160-tall master (1.4% of frame height), which survives a 9:16 crop. Treat 22px as the absolute floor.
- Contrast against `#0B1024` must stay above 4.5:1. `--mute` `#7A8290` gives 5.1:1. Do not dim it.
- It appears once, on the end card only. Do not also burn it under UI-09 — the honest footnote
  there does that job in the product's own voice.

## Two rules for every text frame in this film

**1. Battery percentages never tick inside a continuous take.** In clips 02 and 05 the number
changes *across a rack-focus soft frame*, so the shot reads as two moments rather than one
impossible one. A number visibly dropping three points in under two seconds of unbroken time is
a fabrication, and it is the exact species of fabrication this brand is built against.

**2. Nothing on screen was invented for the film.** Every metric shown — energy impact, idle CPU,
login items, projected battery life — is something a Mac actually reports. If a reviewer opens
Activity Monitor after watching this, they should recognise every word.
